method.portfolio: At each Berkshire Hathaway 13F, select the ten priced disclosed securities with the largest reported market values and normalize their disclosed values to 100%.
method.execution: Use the first tradable SPY date on or after the filing date; new weights apply after that close.
method.returnType: Unadjusted daily close price return; dividends excluded for both strategy and benchmark.
method.costs: Transaction costs, taxes and slippage excluded.
method.securityTreatment: Distinct share classes remain separate because the SEC information table reports distinct securities.
